task.purpose: Build manifest criteria H1, H2, H3 (product files). You own: apps/api/src/** and apps/api/tests/** for the health routes, infra/ubuntu/nginx-vc.conf, .env.example, apps/web/package.json, root package.json, apps/api/package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml. Do NOT touch docs/** or infra/ubuntu/README.md (builder B owns them).
acceptance: H1 TDD per the gl-c brief: write the failing tests first (200 /health; 200 /ready on a fake ping; 503 on a failing or slow ping; no auth needed; no host/secret/error text in the body; unknown path still 404; not counted by the anonymous limiter), then implement IN PLACE where the API dispatches routes (find it from apps/api/src/main.ts and index.ts; server.ts ROUTES at ~336 is the OpenAPI route table). Add exact-match nginx locations for /health and /ready in infra/ubuntu/nginx-vc.conf, proxying to the same upstream as the other locations, with no CORS headers, in that file's comment style.

H2: list every env NAME the API process reads (grep process.env and env[...] loaders across apps/api/src, packages/*/src, mcp/*/src; include VC_GATE_APPROVER) and add the missing ones to .env.example with a one-line comment each (required/optional, which surface), in the file's existing grouping and style; no real values. Report the names added, and any name in .env.example that no code reads (do not delete those; just report them).

H3: apps/web/package.json gets start: next start --port 3108. Root package.json: engines.node >=20.16 and packageManager pnpm@<the output of pnpm --version>. Move tsx in apps/api/package.json from devDependencies to dependencies (same version). Update pnpm-lock.yaml only if pnpm requires it (pnpm install --offline), and report whether it changed.

Run the new and touched apps/api test files, apps/api/tests/main.test.ts and pnpm -C apps/api typecheck via scripts/vc-testlock.sh. Record one falsification for H1 (break the ping-timeout or status mapping in a scratch copy, show red, restore).

Commit once on the current branch, staging only your owned files by path, with message 'devops-handover: /health and /ready, .env.example names, start script, node/pnpm pins' and footer 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>'. Report: commit sha, changed files, test commands with pass/fail counts, the falsification, the names added to .env.example, lockfile changed yes/no.
checks: No server starts against real DBs; tests use fakes.
Do not weaken any existing test assertion.
